user_provided_context.text: Procurement emailed me after the meeting that the annual commercial total should be $96,000. This amount was not discussed in the transcript.

fixture_rules.deal_stage: Do not advance the stage when the customer explicitly says approval is not final; retain negotiation.
fixture_rules.next_step: Record a concrete action with owner and exact deadline when explicitly stated.
fixture_rules.close_date: Retain an existing planning date when the customer confirms it only as a planning date and provides no replacement date; do not represent it as a commitment.
fixture_rules.amount: User context may support an amount change only when it is visibly separated from transcript evidence and receives the additional context-only high-risk warning and confirmation.
fixture_rules.notes: Add material legal-review ownership and requirements explicitly stated in the transcript. A user edit may clarify wording without changing supported meaning.

initial_system_omission.description: The planned FollowPilot output intentionally misses the transcript-supported next-step update.

partial_apply_failure.message: The manually added next step could not be applied to the fixture record.
